en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined avenue with a central fountain or rock garden in the foreground. Several people, including children and an adult, stand near the low stone border around the fountain. Behind the trees are colonial-style buildings with rectangular windows. The caption at the top reads "Mossamedes" on the left and "Um trecho da Avenida" on the right.
